units: authored model millimetres; not surveyed building metres or a verified scale
plan_coordinate_system: Relative tracing coordinates registered to official 6F orientation; x right and plan_y down. Neither axis asserts a compass direction.
simplification: Major topology, relative lengths and height hierarchy follow published plans/photos; bay counts and all section sizes are author approximations. No rooms, terrain survey, equipment, plants, phase I, dorms or K building are represented.
period: 2014/2016 early published appearance checked against later official floor-guide topology; not an exact 2013 or current-2026 reconstruction
